components.name: Primary Button (Inquiry Submit)
components.description: Filled square submit button on the dark inquiry-form panel; label left, glyph-style affordance right.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid #ffffff; background: #ffffff; color: #c83d22; padding: 17px 20px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 20px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Manrope', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #f2ede8; outline: 3px solid #e85838; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Button (Hero CTA)
components.description: Outlined transparent button over photography; used as the hero primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55); padding: 15px 18px; color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Manrope', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost span { margin-left: 25px; color: #e85838; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: #e85838; outline: 3px solid #e85838; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Underline Text Input
components.description: Borderless field on the dark inquiry form; single bottom-border underline, brightens on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; font-family: 'Manrope', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); background: transparent; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 0 13px; border-radius: 0; outline: none; font-size: 14px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #ffffff; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: #ffffff; outline: none; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Flat uppercase nav links; the final entry (conversion path) is permanently colored ember orange.
components.html: GalleryPlanSeasonsAreaInterest
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; font-family: 'Manrope', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #092939; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: #e85838; outline: none; } .ds-nav-active { color: #e85838 !important; }

components.name: Filter Chip / Tab
components.description: Square uppercase filter control used for the gallery filter row and the plan-explorer level tabs; active state fills ember orange.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-chip { border: 0; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); background: transparent; color: #b9c8ca; padding: 16px 21px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.13em; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Manrope', Arial, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-chip.active, .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { background: #e85838; color: #ffffff; outline: none; }

components.name: Fact Card (Strip Facts)
components.description: Square tonal stat tile used in the hero strip to show a house fact (bedrooms, bathrooms, etc.).
components.css: .ds-card-fact { padding: 23px 25px; background: #e1eeeb; border-right: 1px solid rgba(8,56,72,.18); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(8,56,72,.18); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'Manrope', Arial, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; } .ds-card-fact dt { font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-weight: 700; color: #49626b; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; } .ds-card-fact dd { margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Black', Impact, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(25px,2.4vw,38px); line-height: 1; } .ds-card-fact small { font-family: 'Manrope', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

components.name: Map List Item (Place)
components.description: Selectable square list row pairing with the map; active state fills deep lake blue.
components.css: .ds-place { width: 100%; min-height: 112px; text-align: left; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(8,56,72,.18); padding: 18px 23px; background: #eef5f0; color: #092939; display: flex; flex-direction: column; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Manrope', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-place span { font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #b6351d; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-place b { font-family: 'Archivo Black', Impact, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.15; margin: 8px 0; } .ds-place small { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.45; color: #4d666e; } .ds-place.active, .ds-place:hover, .ds-place:focus-visible { background: #083848; color: #ffffff; outline: none; } .ds-place.active small { color: #bfd0d2; }

narrative.overview:
Blake Point House presents itself as a field guide, not a listing: a documentary-photography survey of a real furnished house, framed by an MLS floor plan and read against the fall-through-spring calendar of the North Shuswap. The palette is drawn from the lake itself — a deep, almost-black lake blue as the dominant dark, a misted mineral-green paper as the dominant light — with a single ember-orange accent reserved for calls to action, numbering, and seasonal signal. Layout is hard-edged and editorial: square blocks, ruled dividers, numbered sections (01—31), and a strict two-font system (a blunt display slab over a clean humanist body) rather than soft, resort-brochure styling. The signature technical gesture is a restrained Three.js topographic field — thin contour lines and drifting ember particles behind the seasons section — that shifts hue from ember through frost to spring green as the visitor scrolls, gated off on small screens, reduced-motion, and save-data connections so the experience degrades to static ruled lines rather than breaking.

This is a Persuade-mode surface built to qualify, not hype: it must feel more visual, dynamic, and premium than a generic vacation-rental page while staying candid, calm, and residential. It explicitly rejects resort marketing, rounded/soft touches, and drop-shadow "app" chrome in favor of flat tonal layering and hard-edged blocks.
keyCharacteristics: Two-tone dominant palette (deep lake blue / misted mineral paper) with a single ember-orange accent used sparingly for action and orientation.
Flat, tonal, hard-edged blocks — no rounded corners, no drop shadows for elevation.
Archivo Black display type set tight and negative-tracked; Manrope for everything readable.
Documentary photography and Matterport-derived floor-plan geometry as the visual evidence base.
A restrained, seasonally color-shifting Three.js topographic field as the one signature motion moment, hard-gated by viewport size, reduced motion, and save-data.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Ember orange is the only saturated hue in the system; every other surface is lake-blue or mineral-paper. If a new element needs emphasis, it earns orange — nothing else.

rules.name: The Uppercase Label Rule
rules.body: Every functional label — nav, eyebrows, buttons, filters, form field labels — is 700-weight, 8–10px, uppercase, with .1em+ letter-spacing. Never mix in sentence-case labels next to this system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit at the same visual depth at rest; separation comes from color contrast and hairline rules, never a shadow. Shadows are reserved for the one case where content sits over unpredictable imagery (the map).

dos: Do keep every corner square (0px radius) — buttons, cards, images, form fields, even third-party map markers.
Do reserve ember orange (#e85838) for action, orientation, and seasonal signal only; every other surface stays lake-blue or mineral-paper.
Do set uppercase functional labels (nav, buttons, eyebrows, form labels) at 700-weight, 8–10px, with ≥.1em letter-spacing.
Do gate any new motion-heavy feature behind the same triad this system already uses: prefers-reduced-motion, a ≤900px viewport check, and navigator.connection.saveData.
Do convey depth with tonal layering and hairline rules, not shadows, except where content sits over unpredictable photography (e.g. the map).
donts: Don't add box-shadow elevation to cards, buttons, or panels — this system is flat by rule.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color; the palette is deliberately two-tone-plus-one-accent.
Don't round any corners, including on embedded third-party widgets (Leaflet markers/popups already get overridden to square).
Don't let the Three.js seasonal field run unconditionally — it must stay lazy-loaded and gated, never a blocking or always-on animation.
